title: change agent sdk api to include emojiChar for completion group
body: right now agent can only return `string[]` for completions in CompletionGroup but need emojiChar and eventually other items such as colors and descriptions

linked_prs.title: Parameter completion emoji in Schema Config
linked_prs.body:
Allow agent to specify the emoji for parameters in completions using the SchemaConfig file.

Closes #1487

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue requests an enhancement to the agent SDK API to support richer completion group outputs, which directly affects agent system behavior and LLM operation, specifically in how agent completions are structured and returned. This aligns with agent-specific component changes.
